test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 16 Sept 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: As of July 2022, which state government among the following implemented the Kalyana Lakshmi and Shaadi Mubarak Scheme?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Telangana**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **Government of Telangana** has a welfare programme called the **Kalyana Lakshmi Scheme and Shaadi Mubarak,** a cutting-edge programme for all the state's poor residents.
 
• The programme provides aid in the **amount of Rs.1,00,116** with the goals of preventing underage marriages and helping financially struggling families with the costs of marriage.
 
• The beneficiaries totalled 3,90,000 as of March 2018.
 
• A Telangana resident** girl over the age of 18** who is a member of any group and whose parents' combined yearly income does not exceed 2 lakhs is eligible for the Scheme.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The **Kalyana Lakshmi scheme** aims to give brides from **SC, ST, and minority families financial help**. In accordance with the **Kalyana Lakhsmi** plan agreement, financial assistance will be transferred to the mother's bank account at the time of the bride's marriage.
 
• This programme, which helps decrease arranged marriages and **raise female literacy, **only accepts female applicants who are at least **18 years old **(considered the marriageable age in India). With the** Kalyana Lakshmi Scheme**, women will have more power and financial freedom.
 
• The **Telangana Shaadi Mubarak Scheme's **primary goal is to offer financial support to families when their daughters get married. Through this programme, a family of a girl who is unable to afford the costs of marriage owing to their precarious financial situation will receive financial support in the **amount of Rs. 100116.**
 
• The **Telangana Shaadi Mubarak **scheme would empower women. Now that the **Telangana government** is going to provide financial aid, the girl's family no longer needs to rely on others to cover the costs of the marriage. Additionally, this plan will aid in **lowering the number of child marriages.**
